explication: Signal Android is a secure messaging app for sending messages and media, making voice/video calls, and managing an account across devices. The principal user workflow is composing or receiving a message, then communicating over Signal’s network; the README establishes these capabilities, but the excerpts do not expose the full message-processing path. Account registration and restoration, calling, device transfer, and storage synchronization are distinct product branches. The graph also shows app dependency wiring and encrypted local database state. Several subsystem links are omitted because their invoking code was not sampled.
